instruction: Candid documentary full shot at eye-level inside a motion capture studio with a red carpet and dark red partition screens. On the left, the bearded man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing left in profile. Behind him, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands facing left, extending her right arm to place her hand on his upper back. Bright overhead lighting illuminates the room, highlighting the red carpet and neutral-colored walls with white radiators in the background.
